commit a2641001e13afe15ca8488be7d739203471fee77

Global Game Jam 2016: push every raised block down in the fewest moves.
Upstream is webpack + Redux + virtual-dom + FastClick, with optional
sound. This port destacks to classic scripts. The thirty jam levels
are kept. Progress is a private save (level + bests). Drag the green cube
and it slides along the isometric faces; tap an adjacent block; arrow
keys still work. Audio stays behind (Safari already skipped it).
